cards.name: Goblin
cards.lore: Fearful of many things, but partial to a vermin sandwich.

cards.name: Archer
cards.lore: "I don't miss." — Every archer, right before missing.

cards.name: Barbarian
cards.lore: Trained by no one, feared by everyone. Mostly feared because of the screaming.

cards.name: Knight
cards.lore: The kingdom's finest. Polished armour hides a spectacular collection of bruises.

cards.name: Wizard
cards.lore: Years of magical study. Thousands of gold in reagents. Wages still less than a goblin.

cards.name: Dragon
cards.lore: When it speaks, kingdoms listen. When it breathes, kingdoms burn.

cards.name: Stone Wall
cards.lore: The first answer to every problem. Usually the second answer too.

cards.name: Lumber Camp
cards.description: All friendly units deal +1 damage. Upgrade: +1 more.
cards.lore: Axes for trees, edges for everything else.

cards.name: Farm
cards.lore: Food is mana. Mana is power. This farmer has no idea what he's contributing to.

cards.name: Mana Spring
cards.lore: Nobody can explain where the water comes from. Nobody is asking anymore.

cards.name: Healer's Hut
cards.description: Heals all friendly units 3 HP every 8s. Upgrade: heals every 4s.
cards.lore: "Rest," she says. "It'll hurt less tomorrow." She is usually right.

cards.name: Stone Mason
cards.description: Repairs all friendly walls & structures 8 HP every 10s. Upgrade: every 5s.
cards.lore: Builds walls by day, repairs them by night. He's given up asking why they keep breaking.

cards.name: Blacksmith
cards.description: All friendly units deal +2 damage. Upgrade: +2 more.
cards.lore: Hammer, anvil, fire. In that order. He has opinions about everything else.

cards.name: Barracks
cards.lore: Turns gold into goblins. Economists are still debating whether that's profitable.

cards.name: Arcane Tower
cards.lore: The archers it trains insist they learned everything naturally.

cards.name: Dragon Lair
cards.lore: Do not approach. Do not inquire. Absolutely do not ask about the rent.

cards.name: Sharpen Blades
cards.lore: The whetstone whine echoes across camp. Everyone quietly checks their grip.

cards.name: Fortify
cards.description: Heal all your units for 12 HP.
cards.lore: "Walk it off." — Official battle doctrine.

cards.name: Skeleton
cards.lore: Died once, but keeps showing up. Very dedicated.

cards.name: Troll
cards.lore: You'll know it's coming. You'll have plenty of time to not do anything about it.

cards.name: Crossbow
cards.lore: Trained to hold position and let the enemy close the distance.

cards.name: Paladin
cards.lore: Righteous, armoured, and absolutely insufferable at dinner.

cards.name: Rogue
cards.lore: "What wall?" — The Rogue, from the other side of the wall.

cards.name: Catapult
cards.lore: A siege weapon is most effective when the enemy comes to it.

cards.name: Werewolf
cards.lore: Formerly a reasonable accountant.

cards.name: Golem
cards.description: Stone titan — massive HP and damage.
cards.lore: Was told to hold the line. Has been holding it for two hundred years.

cards.name: Pixie
cards.description: Tiny and flying — bypasses all walls.
cards.lore: Shoots first, asks never.

cards.name: Ogre
cards.lore: Large. Loud. Effective. Not necessarily in that order.

cards.name: Crypt
cards.lore: Nobody asked what's in there. Everyone agrees not to.

cards.name: Troll Den
cards.lore: Smells terrible. Keeps the neighbours away.

cards.name: Garrison
cards.lore: A crossbow and a grudge, supplied on rotation.

cards.name: Cathedral
cards.lore: Blessed walls. Blessed warriors. Blessed inconvenient for the enemy.

cards.name: Rogue Den
cards.lore: No sign. No address. Impossible to miss.

cards.name: Siege Works
cards.lore: The engineers here have never met a wall they didn't want to destroy.

cards.name: Dark Shrine
cards.lore: Full moon schedule posted on the door.

cards.name: Iron Forge
cards.lore: Hammers day and night. Nobody sleeps within a mile.

cards.name: Fairy Ring
cards.lore: "Step inside the ring," they said. "It'll be fun," they said.

cards.name: Ogre Den
cards.lore: Listed as "residential" in the tax records.

cards.name: Rally
cards.description: Heal all your units for 4 HP.
cards.lore: A rousing speech, a quick bandage — good as new.

cards.name: Haste
cards.lore: Legs moved so fast they filed a formal complaint.

cards.name: Iron Skin
cards.description: All your units gain +15 max HP.
cards.lore: Toughen up. Literally.

cards.name: Eagle Eye
cards.description: All your units gain +25 attack range.
cards.lore: See further. Regret it only slightly more often.

cards.name: War Drums
cards.lore: The rhythm of violence.

cards.name: Bloodlust
cards.description: All your units surge with furious speed.
cards.lore: Faster. Angrier. Marginally more coordinated.

cards.name: Plague Rat
cards.description: Swarm melee. Incredibly fast attack speed.
cards.lore: One is an annoyance. A hundred is a catastrophe.

cards.name: Bandit
cards.lore: Honest work never paid this well.

cards.name: Bat
cards.lore: Skittish by nature — prefers prey that can't fight back.

cards.name: Scorpion
cards.lore: Armoured, venomous, grumpy. Triple threat.

cards.name: Shield Guard
cards.lore: Move? Why would I move?

cards.name: Centaur
cards.lore: The upper half writes poetry. The lower half doesn't know.

cards.name: Harpy
cards.description: Flying ranged — swoops over walls and shoots.
cards.lore: Sings beautifully. Fights savagely. Never at the same time.

cards.name: Specter
cards.lore: Died defending the post. Still defending it.

cards.name: Lizardman
cards.lore: Cold-blooded. Professionally and personally.

cards.name: Ballista
cards.description: Siege bolt — extreme range, fires over walls.
cards.lore: "Fire the ballista!" — said with far too much enthusiasm every time.

cards.name: Vampire
cards.lore: Charming until the biting starts. Sometimes also during the biting.

cards.name: Griffin
cards.lore: Half eagle, half lion, all opinion.

cards.name: Fire Mage
cards.description: Glass cannon — scorches enemies through walls.
cards.lore: Extremely dangerous. Mostly to itself.

cards.name: Executioner
cards.description: Devastating melee blow — one hit, one kill.
cards.lore: Does not like being told there is more than one swing allowed.

cards.name: Mammoth
cards.description: Armored beast — crushes through melee lines.
cards.lore: Once a peaceful grazer. Someone put armour on it.

cards.name: Dark Elf
cards.description: Ranged climber — scales walls then snipes.
cards.lore: Watches from the shadows. Shoots from the shadows. Lives in the shadows. Hates dentist appointments.

cards.name: Necromancer
cards.lore: Death is just unemployment with extra steps.

cards.name: Giant
cards.description: Towering brute — enormous HP and damage.
cards.lore: Slow. Inevitable. Cannot open doors, but rarely needs to.

cards.name: Wyvern
cards.description: Fast flying ranged — dominates from the air.
cards.lore: The dragon's practical cousin. Less fire, more punctuality.

cards.name: Behemoth
cards.lore: There is no plan B for a Behemoth. There is often no plan A left either.

cards.name: Rat Burrow
cards.lore: The smell announces them long before they arrive.

cards.name: Bandit Camp
cards.lore: Technically a business.

cards.name: Bat Cave
cards.lore: Dark inside. Dark outside. Mostly just dark.

cards.name: Scorpion Pit
cards.lore: HR has filed fourteen complaints about working conditions.

cards.name: Guard Post
cards.lore: Stand and deliver. Mostly stand.

cards.name: Centaur Stable
cards.lore: It's not a stable, they keep insisting.

cards.name: Harpy Roost
cards.lore: Do not look up.

cards.name: Spirit Well
cards.lore: The water is fine. The spirits are not.

cards.name: Lizard Warren
cards.lore: Warm, underground, and excellent acoustics.

cards.name: Ballista Tower
cards.lore: The elevator is broken. Engineers don't care.

cards.name: Vamp. Coven
cards.lore: Meets at midnight. Dress code: dramatic.

cards.name: Aerie
cards.lore: Spectacular view. Treacherous access. Worth it.

cards.name: Mage Tower
cards.lore: Full of books, experiments, and extremely anxious junior mages.

cards.name: Gallows
cards.lore: Structural integrity questionable. Attendance mandatory.

cards.name: Mammoth Pen
cards.lore: Do not feed after dark. Do not feed before dark either.

cards.name: Shadow Academy
cards.lore: Curriculum: archery, shadows, and sighing at lesser beings.

cards.name: Death Tower
cards.lore: The door is unlocked. Nobody goes in uninvited.

cards.name: Giant's Hall
cards.lore: The ceiling keeps getting raised.

cards.name: Wyvern Roost
cards.lore: Perched atop the cliff where nothing else dares to live.

cards.name: Ancient Altar
cards.lore: Old beyond memory. Hungry beyond measure.

cards.name: Field Medic
cards.description: Heal all your units for 6 HP.
cards.lore: Not a real medic. Effective anyway.

cards.name: Titan Blood
cards.description: Titan ichor flows through your ranks — all units gain +6 attack.
cards.lore: Thick. Extremely thick.

cards.name: Sniper Scope
cards.description: All your units gain +30 attack range.
cards.lore: For those who believe range is the solution to all problems.

cards.name: Battle Cry
cards.lore: Loud. Effective. No subtlety whatsoever.

cards.name: Vine Golem
cards.description: Slow forest brute — twisted vines for fists.
cards.lore: The forest did not build it. The forest became it.

cards.name: Cave Bat
cards.lore: Releases a cloud of confusion before the claws arrive.

cards.name: Thornbeast
cards.description: Climbing beast covered in razor thorns.
cards.lore: Whatever it used to be, the forest has claimed it fully.

cards.name: Elder Treant
cards.lore: It has been here since before the Fracture. It plans to be here after.

cards.name: Frog Knight
cards.lore: Somehow obtained full plate armour. Nobody asked where.

cards.name: Thornwall
cards.description: Reinforced thorn barrier — tougher than stone.
cards.lore: The thorns grow back faster than you can cut them.

cards.name: Ancient Grove
cards.lore: Old enough to remember when the forest covered everything.

cards.name: Ironclad Guard
cards.description: Heavily armored — barely moves, never falls.
cards.lore: Has never retreated. Has never needed to.

cards.name: War Drummer
cards.description: Rallies the march — steady melee brawler.
cards.lore: The beat sets the pace. The pace sets the outcome.

cards.name: Siege Engineer
cards.description: Ranged expert — fires over walls from distance.
cards.lore: Turns distance into an advantage. Turns walls into a suggestion.

cards.name: Shield Wall Soldier
cards.lore: The first to arrive. The last to fall. Usually the first to fall.

cards.name: Grizzled Veteran
cards.lore: Has survived things that should not be survivable. Very annoyed about it.

cards.name: Armory
cards.lore: Every soldier who leaves here is better armed. Most come back.

cards.name: Command Tent
cards.description: +1 max mana. The iron citadel runs on logistics.
cards.lore: Where strategy happens. Mostly arguing, but strategy.

cards.name: Bone Archer
cards.lore: Accuracy improves significantly without the burden of a heartbeat.

cards.name: Wight Knight
cards.description: Armored undead — relentless and hard to kill.
cards.lore: The armour corrodes. The knight does not.

cards.name: Ash Elemental
cards.description: Flying scorched spirit — burns through all defenses.
cards.lore: Born from the Fracture's scorched aftermath. Still burning.

cards.name: Revenant
cards.description: Fast flying ghost — refuses to stay dead.
cards.lore: Kept returning until everyone stopped asking why.

cards.name: Lich Apprentice
cards.lore: Still learning. Still deadly. The tuition is paid in souls.

cards.name: Bone Wall
cards.description: Skeletal barrier — sturdier than it looks.
cards.lore: Unpleasant to look at. Effective to hide behind.

cards.name: Soul Obelisk
cards.lore: Whispers things. Nobody agrees on what.

cards.name: Arcane Golem
cards.description: Heavy arcane construct. Slow but devastating.
cards.lore: Crystallised from raw ley-line energy. It doesn't think. It doesn't need to.

cards.name: Mana Wisp
cards.lore: A fragment of raw mana given just enough awareness to be annoying.

cards.name: Rune Knight
cards.description: Armored melee fighter inscribed with protective runes.
cards.lore: Every rune was carved by hand. He felt every one of them.

cards.name: Spellblade
cards.description: Fast melee fighter with arcane-enhanced strikes.
cards.lore: Half sword technique, half arcane theory. Fully dangerous.

cards.name: Crystal Hydra
cards.description: Multi-headed arcane beast. Ranged, bypasses walls.
cards.lore: Each head was once a separate experiment. The merger was unintentional.

cards.name: Mana Tower
cards.lore: Taps directly into the Spire's mana grid. The Archivist has filed several complaints about this.

cards.name: Crystal Wall
cards.description: Blocks melee units. Sturdier than stone.
cards.lore: Grown, not built. The Spire's lattice does not distinguish between wall and corridor.

cards.name: Leyline Node
cards.lore: An intersection of ley lines, tapped and stabilised. Mostly stabilised.

cards.name: Mana Surge
cards.description: Raw mana floods your units — all gain +14 move speed.
cards.lore: Flood your units with raw mana. The side effects are someone else's problem.

cards.name: Arcane Efficiency
cards.description: Arcane precision extends all ranged units’ attack range by 22.
cards.lore: Optimal resource usage. The Archivist has seventeen papers on the subject.

cards.name: Dryad Sentinel
cards.description: Ranged forest guardian — her arrows find gaps in any wall.
cards.lore: She does not fight for the forest. She is the forest's will made arrow.

cards.name: Mushroom Hulk
cards.description: Massive fungal brute — slow but nearly unstoppable.
cards.lore: The spores are not a side effect. They are the point.

cards.name: Pixie Scout
cards.description: Tiny flying scout — fast, fragile, and surprisingly vicious.
cards.lore: Never trust anything that fits in your ear.

cards.name: Swamp Lurker
cards.description: Slimy ambush predator — bypasses walls by going under them.
cards.lore: The swamp does not give back what it takes.

cards.name: Moss Golem
cards.description: Ancient armoured colossus — centuries of moss and spite.
cards.lore: It was not built in a day. Or a year. Or a century.

cards.name: Spore Tower
cards.description: Periodically launches a Spore Bat at the enemy.
cards.lore: The tower does not stop. Not for weather. Not for war.

cards.name: Mushroom Circle
cards.description: Regenerates nearby units with fungal energy.
cards.lore: Step inside. Don't ask what the spores do.

cards.name: Root Tap
cards.description: Ancient root system — draws mana from the earth each turn.
cards.lore: Every tree in the shard is connected. You just tapped in.

cards.name: Overgrowth
cards.description: All units toughened by forest growth — gain 12 max HP.
cards.lore: The forest heals what it does not consume.

cards.name: Nature's Bounty
cards.description: Restore 7 HP to all your units.
cards.lore: The land provides. Even here.

cards.name: Pollen Rush
cards.description: Spores energise all units — gain +16 move speed.
cards.lore: It's probably not toxic. Probably.

cards.name: Root Bind
cards.description: Roots fortify all your units — gain +25 max HP.
cards.lore: Rooted. Immovable. Unkillable.

cards.name: Wild Surge
cards.description: Primal energy surges through your forces — all units gain +22 move speed.
cards.lore: The Verdant Shard does not negotiate.

cards.name: Battering Ram Crew
cards.description: Slow siege crew — prioritises destroying walls.
cards.lore: They have never met a gate they couldn't open.

cards.name: Cavalry Scout
cards.description: Fast mounted scout — harasses weak ranged units.
cards.lore: Speed is armour. Most of the time.

cards.name: Demolitions Expert
cards.description: High burst damage — ignores walls, destroys them first.
cards.lore: Explosives are a planning tool. Mostly.

cards.name: Sappers
cards.description: Tunnellers — bypass walls, target enemy buildings.
cards.lore: You can't defend what you can't find.

cards.name: Ballista Crew
cards.description: Long-range siege archers — bypass walls, devastate large units.
cards.lore: Precision, patience, penetration.

cards.name: Siege Tower
cards.description: Elevated fortification — boosts nearby unit attack by 2.
cards.lore: Height is an advantage. Build higher.

cards.name: Fortified Wall
cards.description: Iron-reinforced wall — twice the HP of a stone wall.
cards.lore: Iron holds. Stone merely delays.

cards.name: Moat
cards.description: Water barrier — slows all units that cross it. Cannot be destroyed.
cards.lore: The water doesn't stop them. The mud does.

cards.name: Battle Hardened
cards.description: Veterans of the Citadel — all units gain 10 max HP.
cards.lore: Scars are scar tissue. Scar tissue is armour.

cards.name: Iron Discipline
cards.description: Relentless training — all units gain +14 max HP.
cards.lore: The Iron Citadel doesn't breed heroes. It breeds soldiers.

cards.name: Siege Protocol
cards.description: Tactical positioning — all units gain +20 attack range.
cards.lore: Engage from distance. Dictate the terms.

cards.name: Tactical Retreat
cards.description: Regroup and strike harder — all units gain +3 attack.
cards.lore: Retreat is not defeat. It is preparation.

cards.name: Shadow Stalker
cards.description: Undead infiltrator — bypasses walls, targets buildings.
cards.lore: You feel it before you see it. Then you don't see anything at all.

cards.name: Soulrend Witch
cards.description: Dark ranged caster — magically bypasses defences.
cards.lore: She does not cast spells. She tears them out of the world.

cards.name: Bone Colossus
cards.description: Titanic undead siege unit — destroys walls, shrugs off arrows.
cards.lore: It is not one skeleton. It is all of them.

cards.name: Wraith
cards.description: Flying undead spirit — ignores walls, phases through defences.
cards.lore: The cold you feel is not the temperature. It is the memory of warmth.

cards.name: Death Altar
cards.description: Continuously raises weak skeletons from fallen enemies.
cards.lore: Death is not the end here. It is the beginning of service.

cards.name: Necrotic Pool
cards.description: Foul energy restores undead units nearby.
cards.lore: The smell is not decay. It is potential.

cards.name: Graveblight Tower
cards.description: Raises powerful Revenants from the grave at intervals.
cards.lore: The tower remembers everyone who has ever died near it.

cards.name: Undying Rage
cards.description: Death fuels fury — all units gain +4 attack.
cards.lore: They fight harder when they have nothing left to lose.

cards.name: Soul Harvest
cards.description: Drain life energy — restore 10 HP to all units.
cards.lore: The Ashen Wastes give back. Eventually.

cards.name: Plague Spread
cards.description: Plague-driven frenzy — all units gain +10 move speed.
cards.lore: Even the dying don't stop moving.

cards.name: Dark Ritual
cards.description: Forbidden rite — all units gain 20 max HP and are healed for it.
cards.lore: The price is someone else's.

cards.name: Entropy Wave
cards.description: Unleash pure entropy — all units gain +8 attack.
cards.lore: Everything falls apart. You just decided what falls apart first.

cards.name: Techno Imp
cards.description: Tiny flying construct — fast and annoying in numbers.
cards.lore: Someone thought this was a good idea. They were not wrong.

cards.name: Mana Siphon
cards.description: Ranged magic drainer — bypasses walls, feeds off mana.
cards.lore: It doesn't attack you. It drains you. Same outcome.

cards.name: Arcane Turret
cards.description: Stationary magic cannon. Devastating ranged fire. Targets heroes only.
cards.lore: Immovable. Implacable. Inadvisable to stand near.

cards.name: Void Elemental
cards.description: Flying void creature — phases through walls, medium ranged.
cards.lore: It does not come from nowhere. It comes from the space between things.

cards.name: Chronomancer
cards.description: Time-manipulating mage — fast attack speed, magical bypass.
cards.lore: It has already won. It's being polite by playing it out.

cards.name: Arcane Forge
cards.description: Magical enchantment forge — boosts nearby unit attack by 3.
cards.lore: It doesn't make weapons. It makes weapons angry.

cards.name: Null Field
cards.description: Arcane disruption field — mana recharges 50% faster.
cards.lore: It nullifies everything except mana. That was intentional.

cards.name: Crystal Resonance
cards.description: Crystal harmonics reinforce your units — all gain +12 max HP.
cards.lore: The Spire hums. Those who can hear it hum louder.

cards.name: Void Tap
cards.description: Tap into the void — all units gain +20 move speed.
cards.lore: Void energy has side effects. None of them are boring.

cards.name: Temporal Loop
cards.description: Rewind time on your units — all gain 25 max HP and are healed.
cards.lore: They have survived this battle before. They will again.

cards.name: Prism Warden
cards.description: Crystal-armored melee fighter. Tough and steady.
cards.lore: Encased in grown crystal lattice, wardens feel nothing. They are merely patient.

cards.name: Shard Familiar
cards.lore: Broken from the Spire's outer lattice. It remembers being a wall and hates it.

cards.name: Arcane Conduit
cards.description: Ranged structure that fires arcane bolts. Long reach.
cards.lore: Channels raw ley-line energy into a focused beam. The Archivist has banned them from the reading rooms.

cards.name: Resonance Spire
cards.description: Heals nearby friendly units by 2 HP/tick.
cards.lore: The Spire hums at a frequency that knits crystal and flesh alike.

cards.name: Crystalline Shell
cards.description: All your units gain +14 max HP.
cards.lore: A layer of grown crystal over flesh. It itches terribly. Worth it.

cards.name: Reef Crawler
cards.description: Fast melee fighter. Scuttles through debris.
cards.lore: Crabs occupied the reef long before anyone else. They regard all newcomers as temporary.

cards.name: Tide Sprite
cards.description: Tiny flying water spirit. Bypasses walls.
cards.lore: Formed from salt foam and stray magic. Mostly harmless. Mostly.

cards.name: Coral Guard
cards.description: Armored melee fighter clad in living coral.
cards.lore: The coral grows with them. Eventually it becomes unclear where the soldier ends.

cards.name: Crab Shielder
cards.lore: Selectively bred for stubbornness. Turned out that was the crabs' natural state.

cards.name: Seahorse Lancer
cards.description: Fast cavalry. Charges through lighter defences.
cards.lore: The seahorse does the steering. The lancer holds on and hopes.

cards.name: Jellyfish Drifter
cards.description: Slow flying ranged unit. Bypasses walls.
cards.lore: No eyes, no brain, no fear. Effective.

cards.name: Eel Striker
cards.lore: The charge builds in the spine. It releases all at once. It is not subtle.

cards.name: Reef Shark
cards.lore: Doesn't hesitate. Doesn't reconsider. The reef's finest quality.

cards.name: Tide Caller
cards.lore: She doesn't call the tide. She reminds it where it meant to go.

cards.name: Sea Witch
cards.lore: She drowned once, according to the legends. Decided not to stay drowned.

cards.name: Anglerfish Lurker
cards.description: Ambush melee predator. Targets flying units.
cards.lore: The light draws them in. That's the whole strategy. It works every time.

cards.name: Shipwreck Golem
cards.description: Massive armored construct. Slow but devastating.
cards.lore: Assembled from ten sunken Dominion warships. None of them volunteered.

cards.name: Abyssal Hunter
cards.description: Flying deep-sea predator. Long range, bypasses walls.
cards.lore: From a depth no map has measured. It came up. It found the surface disappointing but adequate.

cards.name: Tide Dragon
cards.description: Flying ranged beast. Large and powerful.
cards.lore: Part dragon, part tidal wave. Distinguishing the two is not recommended.

cards.name: Leviathan
cards.description: Colossal slow beast. Unstoppable once moving.
cards.lore: The reef was built around it. Not the other way.

cards.name: Coral Wall
cards.description: Blocks melee advance. Tougher than it looks.
cards.lore: Grown overnight. It takes longer to grow a conscience.

cards.name: Tide Shrine
cards.description: +1 max mana. Channels tidal ley energy.
cards.lore: The tides flow twice a day. The mana flows whenever you need it.

cards.name: Siren's Post
cards.description: Ranged structure. Lures enemies toward it, then attacks.
cards.lore: The song is optional. The attack is not.

cards.name: Reef Mender
cards.description: Heals nearby friendly units by 2 HP/tick.
cards.lore: The reef heals itself. Given enough time. The mender speeds up the schedule.

cards.name: Depth Anchor
cards.lore: Chains the ley current in place so it can't drift. The ley current resents this.

cards.name: Kraken Beacon
cards.description: Spawns a Reef Crawler every 5 seconds.
cards.lore: The signal draws them from the deep. They don't ask why. They never ask why.

cards.name: Tidal Surge
cards.description: All your units gain +14 move speed.
cards.lore: The tide comes in whether or not you're ready. Might as well use it.

cards.name: Pearl Power
cards.lore: Ground from pressure and time. Both are available in the deep.

cards.name: Deep Resilience
cards.description: All your units gain +12 max HP.
cards.lore: Depth hardens everything. Skin, shell, resolve.

cards.name: Current Mastery
cards.description: All ranged units gain +20 attack range.
cards.lore: Read the current. Let it carry your attack further than your arm could reach.

cards.name: Wind Sprite
cards.description: Tiny flying ranged spirit. Fast and bypasses walls.
cards.lore: Condensed from high-altitude mana. It doesn't weigh enough to be affected by gravity, which it considers a personal achievement.

cards.name: Air Sprite
cards.description: Flying ranged attacker. Light and quick.
cards.lore: Older than the Dominion. Smaller than a fist. Has an opinion about everything.

cards.name: Zephyr Scout
cards.description: Fast flying melee scout. Bypasses walls.
cards.lore: First in, last to ask questions.

cards.name: Skyguard
cards.lore: Trained to fight at altitude. The training is mostly about not looking down.

cards.name: Cloud Hawk
cards.description: Fast flying ranged beast. Bypasses walls.
cards.lore: Bred from the raptors that roosted on the pre-Fracture watchtowers. Now significantly less tame.

cards.name: Sky Mage
cards.lore: Calls the storm. The storm doesn't always come. She calls it again. Eventually it does.

cards.name: Lightning Archer
cards.lore: The arrows are made of compressed storm. The quiver is a weather system.

cards.name: Gale Warden
cards.description: Flying ranged magic unit. Steady at altitude.
cards.lore: Wardens of the upper air currents. They treat wind as terrain and fight accordingly.

cards.name: Sky Sentinel
cards.lore: Encased in sky-iron. Somehow still airborne. This has never been fully explained.

cards.name: Thunder Drake
cards.description: Large flying ranged beast. Electrical attack.
cards.lore: Rides storm fronts. Feeds on lightning. Inconvenient in most weather.

cards.name: Cloudborn Colossus
cards.description: Massive flying melee unit. Unstoppable at altitude.
cards.lore: Formed from a thunderhead that decided to take a more direct approach.

cards.name: Sky Leviathan
cards.description: Colossal flying beast. Dominates the airspace.
cards.lore: The Sky Dominion did not build this. They found it. They are still not sure who it belongs to.

cards.name: Gust Wall
cards.description: Blocks melee. Made of condensed wind.
cards.lore: Not technically a wall. Technically a sustained gale. Practically identical.

cards.name: Wind Shrine
cards.lore: Taps the upper ley current. The Cloudmarshal has three per island. She counts them.

cards.name: Storm Tower
cards.lore: Discharges continuously. The operators wear rubber boots. This is considered standard kit.

cards.name: Aerie Roost
cards.description: Spawns a Wind Sprite every 5 seconds.
cards.lore: The sprites nest here. They leave when called. Sometimes before they're called.

cards.name: Sky Beacon
cards.lore: Broadcasts on the ley frequency. Mana responds like it has somewhere to be.

cards.name: Cloudfort
cards.lore: Compressed cloudstuff, hardened by altitude magic. Nothing gets through. Nothing legitimate, anyway.

cards.name: Thunder Battery
cards.lore: The Cloudmarshal designed this personally. It shows.

cards.name: Wind Surge
cards.lore: The wind behind you. Always has been.

cards.name: Feather Step
cards.description: All ranged units gain +20 attack range.
cards.lore: Altitude changes perspective. Arrows understand this.

cards.name: Lightning Strike
cards.lore: Channel the storm. Direct application.

cards.name: Aerial Volley
cards.lore: High-altitude resilience training. The survivors are very resilient.

cards.name: Sky Surge
cards.lore: Pure electrical charge. Distributed equally. Approximately.

cards.name: Cloud Cover
cards.description: Heals all your units for 8 HP.
cards.lore: The cloud provides. It always has.

cards.name: Ember Crawler
cards.description: Cheap fast melee. Swarms in numbers.
cards.lore: Born from cracked magma seams. Hungry before it knows anything else.

cards.name: Cinder Hound
cards.lore: The mountain breeds them. Nobody taught them to hunt. They just do.

cards.name: Magma Archer
cards.lore: The bolts cool mid-flight. They arrive as slag. Still hurts.

cards.name: Scorch Bat
cards.lore: Wings like burnt parchment. Eyes like embers. Very annoying.

cards.name: Ash Stalker
cards.description: Melee. Bypasses walls through ashfall cover.
cards.lore: Moves under the ash cloud. You won't see it until it's inside your lines.

cards.name: Pyroclast Runner
cards.lore: Outruns the lava flow by staying just ahead of it. A tactic, apparently.

cards.name: Fire Salamander
cards.lore: Technically amphibious. Prefers magma pools. No one argues with it.

cards.name: Cinder Knight
cards.lore: Forged in the caldera. The armour is the result. So is the disposition.

cards.name: Ash Revenant
cards.description: Bypasses walls. Risen from the Fracture-scorched dead.
cards.lore: The Fracture left burns on everything. Some of the burns got up again.

cards.name: Lava Troll
cards.description: Slow but massive HP. Hard to stop.
cards.lore: Not made of lava. Just coated. It doesn't see a difference.

cards.name: Ember Wyrm
cards.lore: Hatches in lava and immediately considers itself above everyone else. Literally.

cards.name: Flame Warden
cards.description: Heavy melee. Holds the line in the fire.
cards.lore: The Warlord's honour guard. Still standing when everything behind them has burned.

cards.name: Volcanic Golem
cards.lore: Constructed from solidified magma. The Warlord just pointed at a lava flow and said 'do that, but useful.'

cards.name: Inferno Drake
cards.lore: Older than the Fracture. Larger than your base. Annoyed at being woken up.

cards.name: Molten Colossus
cards.description: Titanic melee. Max HP. Ends battles alone.
cards.lore: The mountain's last argument. There are no others after this one.

cards.name: Cinder Wall
cards.lore: Ash compacted under pressure. Holds well. Smells terrible.

cards.name: Ash Turret
cards.lore: The mechanism clogs. That's fine. So does the enemy.

cards.name: Magma Vent
cards.lore: A crack in the rock. Something keeps coming out of it. This is considered a feature.

cards.name: Fire Forge
cards.description: +1 max mana. The heat fuels the ley channels.
cards.lore: Taps geothermal ley-lines. Side effects include singed eyebrows and increased mana capacity.

cards.name: Lava Spire
cards.description: Long-range high-damage structure. Targets ground units only.
cards.lore: The Warlord erected one before every major offensive. He considers them motivational.

cards.name: Ember Shrine
cards.lore: Ancient. Predates the Warlord. He keeps it lit because it keeps working.

cards.name: Burning Rush
cards.lore: Light it on fire. Motivation follows naturally.

cards.name: Smelted Blade
cards.lore: Reforged in volcanic slag. Not technically an improvement. Except in every way.

cards.name: Volcanic Hide
cards.lore: A coat of hardened lava. Uncomfortable. Impractical. Works extremely well.

cards.name: Inferno Surge
cards.lore: The mountain's blessing. The mountain is not subtle.

cards.name: Spore Crawler
cards.description: Cheap fast melee. Floods in from the deep.
cards.lore: Smells like wet earth and something older. Moves faster than it should.

cards.name: Mycelium Guard
cards.description: Sturdy melee. Fibrous and hard to kill.
cards.lore: The mycelium doesn't bleed. It just regrows.

cards.name: Spore Archer
cards.lore: The bolts carry seeds. Everything they hit becomes a garden eventually.

cards.name: Rot Stalker
cards.description: Fast melee. Hunts at the edges.
cards.lore: It learned to run from something in the deep. That thing is still down there.

cards.name: Fungal Shambler
cards.description: Slow but durable. Hard to stop entirely.
cards.lore: It forgets what it was. The fungus doesn't.

cards.name: Bloom Sprite
cards.lore: Too light to be dangerous alone. There are never fewer than twenty.

cards.name: Toadstool Knight
cards.description: Heavy melee. Dense cap, hard to dent.
cards.lore: Grew the armour. Didn't need a smith.

cards.name: Spore Bat
cards.lore: Wings coated in something that makes your eyes water.

cards.name: Bloom Wisp
cards.lore: Not alive exactly. Not dead exactly. In between, and perfectly content.

cards.name: Mycelium Hulk
cards.lore: The oldest growth in the deep. It remembers when there was light down here.

cards.name: Rot Titan
cards.lore: The rot doesn't stop. It never stopped. It just got bigger.

cards.name: Spore Colossus
cards.description: Legendary walker. Releases spores on each attack.
cards.lore: The Root Queen grew it for this. One purpose. It doesn't know any others.

cards.name: Mycelium Wall
cards.lore: Cut it down. It comes back in an hour.

cards.name: Spore Vent
cards.description: Releases clouds that heal nearby units.
cards.lore: The smell takes some getting used to. The healing doesn't.

cards.name: Fungal Den
cards.lore: It hums at a frequency that makes the walls vibrate.

cards.name: Root Snare
cards.description: Ranged tower. Shoots binding root projectiles. Targets ground units only.
cards.lore: The roots never retract. The battlefield gets harder to cross by the hour.

cards.name: Bloom Spire
cards.description: Tall ranged tower. Long reach, good damage. Targets flying units only.
cards.lore: Whatever it's firing, it doesn't run out.

cards.name: Rot Shrine
cards.lore: Nobody built it. It grew.

cards.name: Spore Cloud
cards.lore: Breathe it in. Stop complaining.

cards.name: Mycelium Surge
cards.description: All your units gain +2 ATK and +2 max HP.
cards.lore: The network pulses once. Everyone connected feels it.

cards.name: Deep Growth
cards.description: All your units are healed for 5 HP.
cards.lore: The deep heals things. Some of them wished it wouldn't.

cards.name: Spore Surge
cards.lore: The Root Queen doesn't shout commands. She just surges.

cards.name: Root Wraith
cards.description: Flying ranged. Passes through walls silently.
cards.lore: It was a person once. The network disagrees.

cards.name: Queen Spore
cards.description: Legendary. A fragment of the Root Queen herself.
cards.lore: She sent a piece of herself. The piece has opinions now.

cards.name: Fungal Bloom
cards.description: All your units gain +4 max HP and are fully healed.
cards.lore: The bloom comes once. It's always exactly what you needed.

cards.name: Frost Crawler
cards.description: Cheap fast melee. Swarms from the glacier.
cards.lore: Hatched from ice. No one is sure what laid the eggs.

cards.name: Ice Shard
cards.lore: You can see straight through it if you hold it up to the light. Don't.

cards.name: Glacier Guard
cards.description: Slow, high HP. Hard to shift.
cards.lore: The glacier doesn't hurry. It doesn't need to.

cards.name: Frost Archer
cards.lore: The bolts don't melt. That's the point.

cards.name: Blizzard Runner
cards.description: Very fast melee. Outruns the cold.
cards.lore: Born in a blizzard. Outran it. Still running.

cards.name: Ice Wraith
cards.lore: It hovers where the temperature drops suddenly. Always does.

cards.name: Rime Stalker
cards.description: Melee. Methodical, steady, hard to stop.
cards.lore: Moves like a glacier. Same destination as a glacier.

cards.name: Frozen Knight
cards.description: Heavy melee. Encased in glacial armour.
cards.lore: The armour grew over years. The knight inside is still functional.

cards.name: Cold Snap
cards.lore: The name is onomatopoeia. You only understand it when it happens.

cards.name: Frost Drake
cards.lore: The cold keeps it alive. Warmth is the only thing it fears.

cards.name: Glacier Titan
cards.lore: The glacier calved it. Now it walks. The glacier seems pleased.

cards.name: Ice Colossus
cards.description: Enormous melee. Nearly impossible to stop.
cards.lore: It stopped once. The ice that formed overnight is still there.

cards.name: Permafrost Wyrm
cards.lore: The Pale Engine keeps it leashed. You can't tell which one is angrier about this.

cards.name: Ice Wall
cards.description: Frost wall. Thick and slow to break.
cards.lore: Carved from the glacier face. Replacement is never far away.

cards.name: Frost Turret
cards.description: Ranged tower. Fires frozen bolts. Targets ground units only.
cards.lore: The bolts arc beautifully before impact. Aesthetics are unintentional.

cards.name: Glacier Beacon
cards.lore: It hums at the same frequency as the ice. Nobody knows why. Nobody is comfortable with it.

cards.name: Blizzard Spire
cards.description: Long-range tower. Reach and damage. Targets flying units only.
cards.lore: Built into the glacier itself. The spire and the mountain are the same thing now.

cards.name: Cryo Forge
cards.description: Heal aura. Restores nearby units every 5s.
cards.lore: The cold preserves. The forge applies this principle to injuries.

cards.name: Pale Shrine
cards.lore: Older than the glacier. The glacier grew around it.

cards.name: Frost Surge
cards.lore: The cold focuses things. Pain mostly.

cards.name: Glacier Hide
cards.description: All your units gain +3 max HP.
cards.lore: The glacier's patience, compressed.

cards.name: Blizzard Blast
cards.lore: The blizzard doesn't distinguish between enemies. Your units learn from this.

cards.name: Permafrost
cards.description: All your units gain +3 ATK and +3 max HP.
cards.lore: The deepest cold. The kind that changes things permanently.

cards.name: Sand Raider
cards.description: Fast cheap melee. First in, first out.
cards.lore: Paid upfront. Good idea in retrospect.

cards.name: Dune Stalker
cards.lore: Grew up out here. Never saw the point of anywhere else.

cards.name: Desert Archer
cards.lore: The desert teaches patience. The bow teaches the rest.

cards.name: Sandstorm Runner
cards.description: Very fast melee. Outpaces the storm.
cards.lore: Running is how they got here. Running is how they'll leave.

cards.name: Mirage Blade
cards.lore: You see them before they arrive. By then it's too late.

cards.name: Dune Bat
cards.lore: Found a niche. Not sure anyone expected it.

cards.name: Sand Knight
cards.description: Heavy melee. Armoured against the sun and everything else.
cards.lore: The armour was their own idea. It's a good one.

cards.name: Mercenary Captain
cards.lore: Twenty years of not dying. It's its own kind of skill.

cards.name: Mirage Scout
cards.lore: You pay for information. This is the information delivery.

cards.name: Sandstorm Shaman
cards.lore: The storm listens. Nobody is sure why.

cards.name: Dune Colossus
cards.description: Massive melee. The dunes move for it.
cards.lore: Sand collected around something ancient and decided to stay.

cards.name: Desert Titan
cards.description: Heavy melee. Mercenary with very good rates.
cards.lore: Expensive. Worth it. Usually.

cards.name: Sand Wyrm
cards.lore: The dunes don't have it. The dunes are it.

cards.name: Bone Merchant
cards.description: Legendary. The Dune Baron's enforcer. Extremely expensive.
cards.lore: You get what you pay for. You also get what you don't pay for.

cards.name: Sand Wall
cards.lore: The desert provides. Also takes.

cards.name: Oasis Well
cards.description: Heal aura. Restores nearby units every 4.5s.
cards.lore: Water out here means everything.

cards.name: Dune Barracks
cards.lore: Recruitment is ongoing. The market supplies.

cards.name: Mirage Tower
cards.description: Ranged tower. Hard to target. Targets flying units only.
cards.lore: It looks like two towers. You attack the wrong one.

cards.name: Desert Spire
cards.description: Long-range tower. Commands the dunes. Targets ground units only.
cards.lore: Visible for miles. That's the point.

cards.name: Bazaar Post
cards.lore: The Baron pays on delivery. Payment is consistent.

cards.name: Desert Rush
cards.lore: The heat does something to urgency.

cards.name: Mercenary Pact
cards.lore: Better pay. Better results. Simple math.

cards.name: Sandstorm
cards.description: All your units gain +3 max HP.
cards.lore: The storm toughens things. Survivors included.

cards.name: Gold Standard
cards.description: All your units gain +3 ATK and +3 max HP.
cards.lore: The Baron's mark. It means something. Mostly 'expensive'.

cards.name: Avalanche Bear
cards.description: Heavy melee. Charges in like a falling mountain.
cards.lore: The glacier raised it. The glacier also threw it at you.

cards.name: Pale Colossus
cards.description: Glacial melee construct. Enormous and relentless.
cards.lore: A second colossus. The Pale Engine builds what it needs.

cards.name: Glass Dancer
cards.lore: Every shot costs extra. Clients usually agree it was worth it.

cards.name: Canopy Scout
cards.lore: She was mapping the upper canopy when the war found her. She kept mapping.

cards.name: Vine Runner
cards.lore: Raised by the vines, moves like them.

cards.name: Root Creeper
cards.description: Slow tanky melee. Hard to stop.
cards.lore: It doesn't hurry. It doesn't need to.

cards.name: Bark Hound
cards.lore: Not a dog. Not a tree. Something in between that bites very hard.

cards.name: Ancient Sprite
cards.lore: It flickers between branches so fast the canopy looks like it's breathing.

cards.name: Root Wall
cards.lore: It was here before the road. It'll be here after.

cards.name: Canopy Farm
cards.lore: The canopy farms light and converts it. Inefficient for energy. Exceptional for power.

cards.name: Ancient Blessing
cards.lore: The Verdant Canopy's blessing is slow and thorough.

cards.name: Elderwood Guard
cards.lore: Older than the path, sturdier than the stones.

cards.name: Canopy Archer
cards.description: Ranged. Fires from the high branches.
cards.lore: You'll hear the arrow before you see the archer.

cards.name: Ancient Treant
cards.description: Slow but very tanky melee. Massive HP.
cards.lore: It takes a moment to notice you. That moment is your only advantage.

cards.name: Jungle Stalker
cards.description: Fast high-damage melee. Hunts walls first.
cards.lore: The jungle rewards patience in all things except the hunt.

cards.name: Spore Drifter
cards.lore: It releases clouds as it flies. The clouds are the attack.

cards.name: Ancient Barracks
cards.lore: The canopy trains its own. Always has.

cards.name: Canopy Watchtower
cards.description: Ranged tower. Long sight lines. Targets all.
cards.lore: Built into a branch three hundred feet up. The view is everything.

cards.name: Living Thornwall
cards.lore: Cut it down. It grows back. You won't.

cards.name: Elder Shrine
cards.description: Heal aura. Restores nearby units every 4s.
cards.lore: The shrine predates the empire. Maybe the idea of empires.

cards.name: Canopy Growth
cards.lore: The canopy doesn't just grow upward. It grows into everything.

cards.name: Root Network
cards.description: All your units gain +15 move speed.
cards.lore: The roots connect everything. Move where the roots go.

cards.name: Root Walker
cards.description: Massive. Very slow but nearly impossible to stop.
cards.lore: It has walked this path since before the path existed.

cards.name: Canopy Drake
cards.lore: It nests in the high canopy and considers everything below prey.

cards.name: Vine Colossus
cards.lore: The canopy grew a fist. This is what it looks like.

cards.name: Elder Grove
cards.description: Powerful spawner. Releases Ancient Treants slowly.
cards.lore: Old growth. Never cleared. Never should be.

cards.name: Root Surge
cards.description: Roots burst from the ground, dealing 5 damage to all enemy units.
cards.lore: The canopy fights back when it has to.

cards.name: The Elder Warden
cards.lore: It has protected this canopy since before the Fracture. It will protect it after.

cards.name: Shore Scout
cards.lore: First to see the tide, first to run.

cards.name: Tide Runner
cards.lore: The sea gave them speed. The wreck gave them purpose.

cards.name: Salvage Hauler
cards.description: Hauls wreck debris as improvised armor.
cards.lore: Every plate on their back was once someone else's hull.

cards.name: Wave Brawler
cards.lore: They learned to fight in the surf. Everything else is just practice.

cards.name: Drift Net
cards.description: Trawls up shore scouts from the deep.
cards.lore: Throw it in. Pull it out. Something always comes back.

cards.name: Storm Beacon
cards.lore: The storm doesn't notice it. But you do.

cards.name: Wreck Patch
cards.lore: You take what washes up. You use it.

cards.name: Coastal Skirmisher
cards.description: Nimble ranged fighter who harasses from a distance.
cards.lore: Hits hard from far away, then disappears back into the spray.

cards.name: Wreck Diver
cards.description: Surfaces from submerged wrecks to ambush.
cards.lore: They live down there. Among the bones and barnacles.

cards.name: Stormcaller
cards.lore: The coast storms are alive. They taught me to ask nicely.

cards.name: Reef Warden
cards.description: Ancient guardian of the coastal reef.
cards.lore: It was here before the ships. It will be here after.

cards.name: Storm Hawk
cards.lore: It uses the storm. The storm does not notice.

cards.name: Breakwater Wall
cards.description: A sturdy sea wall spawned from salvaged debris.
cards.lore: Built to break the tide. Better at breaking armies.

cards.name: Salvage Dock
cards.lore: The dock doesn't care where they come from. It just sends them.

cards.name: Tidal Fortress
cards.description: A tide-blessed bastion that heals nearby allies.
cards.lore: The tide heals what the storm wounds.

cards.name: Storm Surge
cards.description: Infuses a unit with storm fury.
cards.lore: The storm doesn't discriminate. Neither does this.

cards.name: Riptide
cards.description: Grants the speed of an ocean current.
cards.lore: The current doesn't ask where you want to go.

cards.name: Salvage Charge
cards.description: Detonates salvaged ordnance for area damage.
cards.lore: Wet fuses, bad idea. Dry fuses, worse idea.

cards.name: Tide Stalker
cards.description: Prowls the shallows, striking without warning.
cards.lore: You don't see it. Then it's too late.

cards.name: Tempest Rider
cards.description: Commands the storm from above. Flying.
cards.lore: The lightning obeys. The thunder follows.

cards.name: Wreck Golem
cards.description: Assembled from hull plates and broken masts.
cards.lore: Every ship that sank here. Every sailor lost. All of it, walking.

cards.name: Stormgate
cards.description: Opens a rift in the storm, spawning tempest riders.
cards.lore: The storm has a door. This is it.

cards.name: Maelstrom
cards.description: Conjures a maelstrom that batters all nearby enemies.
cards.lore: The sea isn't angry. It just doesn't notice you.

cards.name: The Harbormaster
cards.description: The iron admiral of the Shattered Coast. Commands the storm itself.
cards.lore: Every wreck on this coast was once a ship that thought it could pass without his permission.

cards.name: Coast Leviathan
cards.description: A massive sea beast that wades through armies.
cards.lore: Older than the coast itself. Possibly older than the sea.

cards.name: Gear Scout
cards.lore: Built to arrive first and report back. They rarely bother reporting.

cards.name: Cog Runner
cards.lore: The clockwork never tires. That's rather the point.

cards.name: Brass Sentry
cards.lore: Wound once. Guards forever.

cards.name: Vault Scrap
cards.description: Spare gear plating bolsters a unit.
cards.lore: Nothing in the vaults is wasted.

cards.name: Gear Assembly
cards.description: Assembles gear scouts from stored components.
cards.lore: The gears mesh. The unit walks out.

cards.name: Pressure Valve
cards.lore: The vaults breathe.

cards.name: Clockwork Tune
cards.description: Adjusts a unit's drive gears for greater speed.
cards.lore: Tighten the spring. Let it run.

cards.name: Clockwork Archer
cards.lore: Precision-built. Never misses the same target twice.

cards.name: Vault Guardian
cards.lore: Sealed chambers don't need guards. But the Automaton insists.

cards.name: Piston Brawler
cards.description: Uses hydraulic pistons to smash through lines.
cards.lore: Impact rated at 40 tonnes. Not tested on living subjects. Yet.

cards.name: Vault Drone
cards.lore: It sees everything the Automaton needs to see.

cards.name: Gear Wall
cards.lore: Immovable. Unless you have the right key.

cards.name: Clockwork Forge
cards.lore: The forge never stops.

cards.name: Vault Repair Bay
cards.lore: Everything broken can be fixed. Given time.

cards.name: Overcharge
cards.description: Overcharges a unit's power core for extra damage.
cards.lore: Warranty void. Performance guaranteed.

cards.name: Gear Sprint
cards.description: Cranks the drive mechanism to maximum.
cards.lore: Too fast to stop. Right on schedule.

cards.name: Vault Burst
cards.description: Discharges a capacitor bank for area damage.
cards.lore: Not recommended for use indoors.

cards.name: Steam Walker
cards.lore: It walks. Nothing stops it.

cards.name: Iron Colossus
cards.lore: Built to hold a vault. Repurposed to take one.

cards.name: Clockwork Titan
cards.lore: The last thing the Automaton built before it stopped building.

cards.name: Titan Forge
cards.lore: Slow. Patient. Inevitable.

cards.name: Drone Array
cards.lore: Fills the air with purpose.

cards.name: Overload
cards.lore: The last reading on the gauge. The one after explosion.

cards.name: The Grand Automaton
cards.description: The Clockwork Vaults' apex construct. Unstoppable.
cards.lore: It was not built to guard the vaults. It built itself. Then it built the vaults around itself.

cards.name: Thornlord
cards.description: Burrows underground at 50% HP, erupting elsewhere to deal AOE damage.
cards.lore: The roots remember every battle. The Thornlord never forgets a face it has crushed.

cards.name: Warlord Kragg
cards.description: Periodically leaps across the battlefield, dealing massive AOE damage on landing.
cards.lore: Kragg has never won a battle with strategy. He has never needed to.

cards.name: The Ashwalker
cards.description: Splits into three ash copies at 50% HP. All copies must be destroyed.
cards.lore: Ash cannot die. It simply disperses, and waits, and reforms.

cards.name: The Archivist
cards.description: Ascends at 120s, descending in an arcane shockwave that silences all enemies.
cards.lore: Every spell ever cast is recorded in its pages. Every counter is also recorded.

cards.name: Tidal Sovereign
cards.description: Dives at 50% HP, resurfacing at the opposite flank with a crushing wave.
cards.lore: The ocean does not ask permission to drown you.

cards.name: Cloudmarshal
cards.description: Ascends into storm clouds at 60% HP, diving into the densest enemy cluster.
cards.lore: The sky has always been his battlefield. The ground is merely where he lands.

cards.name: Cinderwarlord
cards.description: Erupts from a volcano every 40s, crashing down as a blazing meteor.
cards.lore: He was not forged in fire. He simply never left it.

cards.name: Root Queen
cards.description: Fractures into four Spore Nodes at 40% HP, each spawning crawlers.
cards.lore: She does not fight. She propagates.

cards.name: Pale Engine
cards.description: Fires an EMP cascade every 45s, damaging and slowing a random column.
cards.lore: It was built to outlast everything. So far, it has.

cards.name: Dune Baron
cards.description: Plunges into sand at 66% and 33% HP, surfacing beside the strongest enemy.
cards.lore: The desert has no roads. The Baron has no rules.

cards.name: Elder Warden
cards.description: Drives roots into the earth at 50% HP, rooting and damaging a whole column.
cards.lore: It has guarded this forest since before the forest had a name.

cards.name: Grand Automaton
cards.description: Releases a gear cascade when the enemy base falls below 50% HP, slowing a column.
cards.lore: Purpose: victory. Current status: operational.

cards.name: Abyssal Crevasse
cards.lore: They come from above. They always come from above.

cards.name: Air Sanctum
cards.lore: They come from above. They always come from above.

cards.name: Ancient Spring
cards.lore: They come from above. They always come from above.

cards.name: Angler's Trench
cards.lore: It hums at a frequency that makes the walls vibrate.

cards.name: Golem Foundry
cards.description: Spawns an Arcane Golem every 21.5s. A dedicated arcane manufacturing facility.
cards.lore: The arcane circuits never cool.

cards.name: Archer's Keep
cards.lore: It keeps its distance. But it keeps sending.

cards.name: Ash Vortex
cards.lore: Death has a pipeline. This is its source.

cards.name: Ashen Altar
cards.lore: The fire doesn't rest. Neither do they.

cards.name: Cinder Watch
cards.lore: The fire doesn't rest. Neither do they.

cards.name: Bear Run
cards.lore: The ice remembers. It sends what it remembers.

cards.name: Ballista Works
cards.lore: More ammunition. Always more.

cards.name: Siege Yard
cards.lore: More ammunition. Always more.

cards.name: Bandit Hideout
cards.lore: One in, one out. Again. Again.

cards.name: Bark Kennel
cards.lore: Something lives there. It makes more of itself.

cards.name: Bat Cavern
cards.lore: Something lives there. It makes more of itself.

cards.name: Ram Barracks
cards.description: Spawner. Periodically releases Battering Ram Crews.

heroCards.name: Dragon Lord
heroCards.description: HERO: Deploys a mighty Dragon & grants all units +6 attack!
heroCards.lore: Commands dragons. Dragons pretend not to notice.

heroCards.name: Battle Queen
heroCards.description: HERO: Deploys an armored Paladin & fortifies all units with +20 max HP!
heroCards.lore: Won sixteen wars. Lost zero negotiations.

heroCards.name: Storm Caller
heroCards.description: HERO: Deploys a fearsome Wyvern & blesses all units with +40 attack range!
heroCards.lore: The sky does what she says. Eventually.

heroCards.name: Shadow King
heroCards.description: HERO: Deploys a savage Werewolf & surges all units with +25 speed!
heroCards.lore: Feared in twelve kingdoms. Banned from two taverns specifically.

heroCards.name: Death Lord
heroCards.description: HERO: Deploys a sinister Lich Apprentice who summons a skeleton army & hastens all units with -500ms attack cooldown!
heroCards.lore: Death is just a job. A very grim job, but somebody's got to do it.

heroCards.name: Forest Guardian
heroCards.description: HERO: Deploys a mighty Elder Treant & rejuvenates all units with +4 HP heal every 10s!
heroCards.lore: The forest is alive. It has opinions on your strategy.

heroCards.name: Swarm Queen
heroCards.description: HERO: Deploys a mischievous Pixie & commands it to spawn a Spore Bat for you every 10s!
heroCards.lore: The swarm is a family. A very bitey family.

heroCards.name: Graham The All Seeing
heroCards.lore: Sees all. Knows all. Still can't find his keys. Play tested by Graham, who is indeed all seeing.

heroCards.name: Rob The Reckless
heroCards.description: HERO: Deploys Rob — a reckless wizard who explodes at half health, blasting nearby enemies! Also grants all units +3 attack.
heroCards.lore: Big smile. Bigger explosions. The glasses are purely decorative.
